moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That glorious three-day weekend feeling is just around the corner! Who's ready for the Summer Bank Holiday? What are your plans?

angles.name: Last Blast of Summer
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of the summer for England, Wales & Northern Ireland on Monday! Make the most of it before autumn officially arrives.

moments.title: UK Weather: Heat & Thunderstorms
moments.blurb: Parts of the UK, especially the South East, are experiencing temperatures up to 29C today, while central and southern areas face a risk of heavy thunderstorms and localized flooding.

angles.name: Heatwave in the South East
angles.copy: Sun's out, thermometers are soaring! Up to 29C in the South East today. Stay cool if you're out and about! #UKWeather

angles.name: Thunderstorm Watch
angles.copy: Heads up, central and southern UK! Thunderstorms and heavy rain are on the way today, with a risk of localised flooding. Stay safe on the roads. #WeatherWarning

angles.name: Mixed Forecast
angles.copy: From scorchers to downpours! A real mixed bag of weather across the UK today, with highs of 29C in some areas and warnings for heavy rain elsewhere. What's it like where you are?

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2 Continues
moments.blurb: The second matchweek of the 2026/27 Premier League season features key fixtures from Friday, August 28th through Sunday, August 30th.

angles.name: Friday Night Football
angles.copy: Premier League action is back tonight! Crystal Palace host Manchester City in the opener for Matchweek 2. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Premier League
angles.copy: Massive Premier League weekend ahead! Liverpool, Spurs, Chelsea, and Man Utd all in action. Who's got the biggest game to watch?

angles.name: Battle for Points
angles.copy: Matchweek 2 is underway! Every point counts this early in the Premier League season. Which fixture are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Scottish Premiership: Aberdeen v Rangers
moments.blurb: Aberdeen take on Rangers in a Scottish Premiership clash this Sunday, August 30th.

angles.name: Big Scottish Match
angles.copy: It's a big one in the Scottish Premiership this Sunday! Aberdeen host Rangers. Who's taking the points at Pittodrie?

angles.name: Sunday Football North of the Border
angles.copy: Scottish Premiership action this Sunday as Aberdeen face Rangers. Get ready for a classic encounter!

moments.title: National League Weekend Fixtures
moments.blurb: The National League has a full schedule of matches this weekend, including games on Friday, August 28th and the Bank Holiday Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Non-League Action
angles.copy: Don't forget the National League! Plenty of action this weekend, including Friday night games and Bank Holiday Monday clashes. Support your local teams!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Football
angles.copy: National League teams are playing over the Bank Holiday weekend! Who are you hoping to see win?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' maintains its impressive run at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart for a 22nd consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart Reign Continues
angles.copy: 22 weeks at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. What a run!

angles.name: Still the Top Track
angles.copy: Is 'Rein Me In' the song of the summer... and autumn? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean show no signs of budging from the UK #1 spot!

moments.title: Valerie Simpson turns 80
moments.blurb: Valerie Simpson, half of the iconic R&B songwriting and performing duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 80th birthday today.

angles.name: R&B Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson of Ashford & Simpson! A true legend of soul and R&B.

angles.name: Ashford & Simpson Icon
angles.copy: From 'Ain't No Mountain High Enough' to 'Solid', Valerie Simpson has penned hits for decades. Celebrating her 80th birthday today!

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 60
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish singer of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the one and only Shirley Manson! The fierce frontwoman of Garbage still rocking hard.

angles.name: Alt-Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Shirley Manson's 60th today! Her distinctive voice and attitude made Garbage an alt-rock staple. What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Canadian country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known for hits like 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!', celebrates her 61st birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Country Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the incredible Shania Twain on Friday! Still looking good, still sounding great. What's your go-to Shania song?

angles.name: Let's Go Girls!
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Shania Twain this Friday as she turns 61! From 'Any Man of Mine' to 'That Don't Impress Me Much', she's a legend.

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the distinctive voice and creative force behind Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence!
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the mesmerising Florence Welch! The powerhouse vocalist of Florence + The Machine. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', Florence Welch has given us so many anthems. Wishing her a very happy 40th this Friday!

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop icon Gloria Estefan, famous for her work with Miami Sound Machine and her solo career, celebrates her 69th birthday on September 1st.

angles.name: Queen of Latin Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet for Gloria Estefan's 69th birthday this Sunday! A true legend of Latin pop and dance music.

angles.name: Rhythm Is Gonna Get You
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the incredible Gloria Estefan on September 1st! Her music still makes us want to dance.

moments.title: Barry Gibb turns 80
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the legendary singer-songwriter and last surviving member of the Bee Gees, celebrates his 80th birthday on September 1st.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the iconic Sir Barry Gibb on Sunday! The voice behind so many timeless Bee Gees hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Stayin' Alive at 80
angles.copy: From disco anthems to beautiful ballads, Barry Gibb's songwriting is legendary. Wishing him a very happy 80th this September 1st!

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the multi-Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and businesswoman, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Queen Bey, Beyoncé! Let's get Formation and celebrate this icon on September 4th!

angles.name: Run The World!
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to global domination, Beyoncé has redefined pop music. Wishing her a fabulous 45th birthday next Friday!

moments.title: James Bay turns 36
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Bay, known for his distinctive voice and soulful folk-rock sound, celebrates his 36th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday James Bay
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the talented James Bay next Friday! What's your favourite track from the 'Hold Back The River' singer?

angles.name: Hold Back The River
angles.copy: Celebrating James Bay's birthday on September 4th! His soulful sound has captured hearts worldwide. Send him your birthday wishes!

moments.title: Terry Ellis turns 63
moments.blurb: Terry Ellis, a founding member of the influential R&B group En Vogue, celebrates her 63rd birthday on September 5th.

angles.name: En Vogue Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to Terry Ellis of the legendary R&B group En Vogue this Saturday! What's your favourite En Vogue hit?

angles.name: Never Gonna Get It
angles.copy: From 'My Lovin' (You're Never Gonna Get It)' to 'Free Your Mind', Terry Ellis helped define 90s R&B. Celebrating her birthday on September 5th!

moments.title: New Entries on UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart sees Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter with 'Love Sensation' and Sabrina Carpenter re-entering with 'Espresso'.

angles.name: Chart Movers
angles.copy: New entries and big climbers on the UK Singles Chart! Madonna & Kylie Minogue teaming up, plus Sabrina Carpenter's 'Espresso' is back in. What's your new favourite?

angles.name: Pop Royalty Collaboration
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together on the charts with 'Love Sensation'! Two pop legends. You love to see it. #PopMusic
